Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 143, "heading": "V IL NE SUFFIT PAS D’ÊTRE IVROGNE POUR ÊTRE IMMORTEL", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u143-r0030", "target": "— Но, — слабо возразил он, — могильщик — это папаша Местьен.", "source_sha256": "41545b567b2d1c72aaa58d688f13be0839d9ccd960674e13cd5956f99950dba6", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u143-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "27d1ca93ca253bd96d23085b0f90c2ecdad22e1621414c8d64efb7b5b09501d3"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u143-r0031", "target": "— После Наполеона — Людовик Восемнадцатый. После Местьена — Грибье. Земляк, меня зовут Грибье.", "source_sha256": "bece9dce99a0e6c3d3ebde7eb0ee7d2e37f3f6093ef4c82ecff1f13d78b9e5b6", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u143-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "46e9221abb10df28d2fa5eac6f570fed7f3edb266bab2920e1ba55d7f3c9a588"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 8, "chapter": 5, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u143-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent, tout pâle, considéra ce Gribier.", "sha256": "fcb99858b247992bf143ac8eb1dd1ceaf8474f88aa3b30ec83cae2dc90e9eac8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était un homme long, maigre, livide, parfaitement funèbre. Il avait l’air d’un médecin manqué tourné fossoyeur.", "sha256": "bda58217c5f600ba5bce74d8bc55ceded750837019f75d64fb1e7c42286199e0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent éclata de rire.", "sha256": "249bd284b7029fd57349c9f3ff975749ee7b0697fb2926a8bbfdfc913607fd51", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! comme il arrive de drôles de choses ! le père Mestienne est mort. Le petit père Mestienne est mort, mais vive le petit père Lenoir ! Vous savez ce que c’est que le petit père Lenoir ? C’est le cruchon du rouge à six sur le plomb. C’est le cruchon du Suresne, morbigou ! du vrai Suresne de Paris ! Ah ! il est mort, le vieux Mestienne ! J’en suis fâché ; c’était un bon vivant. Mais vous aussi, vous êtes un bon vivant. Pas vrai, camarade ? Nous allons aller boire ensemble un coup, tout à l’heure.", "sha256": "ef2aac64c1af1727613504095c9dd04537dbbfae70cb98fbe7a9a9c70f770a5b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme répondit : — J’ai étudié. J’ai fait ma quatrième. Je ne bois jamais.", "sha256": "b9d9c90872aed5654ed95a237badb29b1cee91cc0ba33623ffc63ba057520736", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le corbillard s’était remis en marche et roulait dans la grande allée du cimetière.", "sha256": "3b50126d01a4c7219d8e8e21c08cd9909f5c9c1ac2594ccd2df7431b9aad2600", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent avait ralenti son pas. Il boitait plus encore d’anxiété que d’infirmité.", "sha256": "ae9c6f7fe942866772ae90b43f7fc0b13f05a1d3e5e679cd09fcb0a9fb044347", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur marchait devant lui.", "sha256": "b3295abdac1d0fc76c490cf666bdc7b3d2da73d3510be23883259b54e53382ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent passa encore une fois l’examen du Gribier inattendu.", "sha256": "46c32d000aab02599759fc3b5233a60e983fe349614da3b0bb8adc68eedc6740", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était un de ces hommes qui, jeunes, ont l’air vieux, et qui, maigres, sont très forts.", "sha256": "1689019a482b341cd4b1bb126e722e8c464e67a5ce4d198a2ee9676ec5cc20c3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Camarade ! cria Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "597dc7767b84718afe0d0800c86c3adc8cf58e709835f8458a01419ba781b683", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme se retourna.", "sha256": "e937d5121c14eb6c4d12fcec37edf98e74a1854366e895ef5922abb6d7f7a1b2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je suis le fossoyeur du couvent.", "sha256": "5fa56a79e930b67176e7d9827cf61d9f87fc1e826a3a561e0a7009df741c5279", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mon collègue, dit l’homme.", "sha256": "6173eeb99fda636a8bc8c89125592698b04230d1a3e3d9f8ec416becfe08c04e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent, illettré, mais très fin, comprit qu’il avait affaire à une espèce redoutable, à un beau parleur.", "sha256": "c26f1d0d2ef0af295f62c699bdf0eb715c246aecd9b399151f1df4e53f6c15f6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il grommela :", "sha256": "0777a8788ea3de02bf08b063dfbddae8928f9f6e0a102212367795a4c6155081", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme ça, le père Mestienne est mort.", "sha256": "224dfec04b3211f012f1a106fddf69c846777e191d920a448c1271ddbe7f3e7e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme répondit :", "sha256": "d07c88f260229f3d9c643231866a419a70a8b343da9f46f09724c6eb598a1a1d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Complètement. Le bon Dieu a consulté son carnet d’échéances. C’était le tour du père Mestienne. Le père Mestienne est mort.", "sha256": "47982d050d4fe073663112224d395c9f1b0b895b6359b25e8caf0968b1987883", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent répéta machinalement :", "sha256": "39236dda8d0c8a07cee15156eaeae141b7d116d7682dec0aca81993b8ffd5b6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le bon Dieu…", "sha256": "c1aef9a3c2669afbda54cae8ffcf420d30453e203351f32df5cc4c251451d83c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le bon Dieu, fit l’homme avec autorité. Pour les philosophes, le Père éternel ; pour les jacobins, l’Être suprême.", "sha256": "8d908f5207ae5d70e9d840f02ff028034e9f19aaec530df6284ed932bf976b36", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce que nous ne ferons pas connaissance ? balbutia Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "f63d1bef1f1a87a18123abc7ec26de17cc294b19a87c5cbf33f1ac2774beb22b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Elle est faite. Vous êtes paysan, je suis parisien.", "sha256": "6535bbd5f3444946cdc3782f41b7360b0599d3da3f630745f70036efe872360a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On ne se connaît pas tant qu’on n’a pas bu ensemble. Qui vide son verre vide son cœur. Vous allez venir boire avec moi. Ça ne se refuse pas.", "sha256": "178edbf6f1da61d28becbbc1b2e7e5061c1f0a206c034ed67a4b16f1ec995f71", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— D’abord la besogne.", "sha256": "deeb427086dfd728ad613f45adf6f4ef351d9b00c69a4437bc1d1da62af75705", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent pensa : je suis perdu.", "sha256": "eb8972ac609149f4ed86255d4ca5e84ef123ba09b0baa2c01c192fa6efd322b6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "On n’était plus qu’à quelques tours de roue de la petite allée qui menait au coin des religieuses.", "sha256": "1ee49d02931af0091f941cbe76eb447a0b9df6e135065f02aae912fb0fc81479", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur reprit :", "sha256": "ab7129cae17361515ae89c25adea75d30e71097eb0e0b81aeaa057914731c8fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Paysan, j’ai sept mioches qu’il faut nourrir. Comme il faut qu’ils mangent, il ne faut pas que je boive.", "sha256": "56c6eb757364454611c1dfd43d4682b93ae31a6602d0fe7be6b07dc8242ada43", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il ajouta avec la satisfaction d’un être sérieux qui fait une phrase :", "sha256": "dab92e9a4cec83f4c5f70b4a77a2ae755d06c33598abc40eea34c31531d1bd3f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u143-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Leur faim est ennemie de ma soif.", "sha256": "1cc42ba3c2cde68087b3ee5a1c28c3a59797657cd44aaf2f946f7a89fe8ee868", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
